content.text: I'm using Fedora version 6.1.0, runs in docker, using postgres database
Attached tomcat server.xml for your reference
I have also encountered error 500 while trying to remove tombstone using fedoraUser role
Appreciate if you could help with this issue too.

HTTP Status 500 – Internal Server Error

Type Exception Report

Message java.lang.NullPointerException

Description The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.

Exception

javax.servlet.ServletException: java.lang.NullPointerException

Note The full stack trace of the root cause is available in the server logs.

Apache Tomcat/9.0.54

So the main issue with this NPE on rollback is the permissions on the transactions. Currently we allow any user to create a new transaction, but can any user commit/rollback any transaction they have an ID for? We don’t track whom started a transaction, so if we want to limit that we’d need to make some changes. Alternatively, we can just allow any user to commit/rollback any transaction that they have the UUID for.
Discussion at the June 2, 2022 Tech Call resulted in a decision to open PUT/DELETE access to the transaction endpoints for fedoraUser to mimic the POST access.
This could conceivably result in a user guessing a transaction ID and commit/rolling back a transaction for the fun of it. There will be a follow-on ticket for this issue.

I tried the examples with version 6.2.0 and instead of getting a 500 error code and stack trace, I got a 403 status code and no stack trace. I’m not sure if its been fixed or not but if not, I will keep working on this, I’d just like a secondary verification please
I just tried this out on main and I am also just getting a 403 Forbidden code, but we’d still like the user to be able to rollback or commit the transaction.

I have granted all users with read, write, append and control permissions, but to no avail.

Hi Danny,

I'm using Fedora version 6.1.0, runs in docker, using postgres database

user: testera
role: fedoraUser

Steps to reproduce:

  1. Create a transaction
    curl -i -u testera:password -X POST "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/fcr:tx"
  2. Rollback transaction
    curl -i -u testera:password -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/fcr:tx/7197e553-6466-4ed8-b248-2ef88ce854c7"

Attached tomcat server.xml for your reference

server.xml

Hi Danny,

One more thing:
I have also encountered error 500 while trying to remove tombstone using fedoraUser role

Steps to reproduce:

  1. create container
    curl -i -u tester:password -X PUT "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test"
  2. delete container
    curl -i -u tester:password -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test"
  3. delete tombstone
    curl -i -u tester:password -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test/fcr:tombstone

Appreciate if you could help with this issue too.
